description: The seating plan of the 26th Knesset plenum for its swearing-in (published by the Knesset Spokesperson): where a member sits, with the seats either side, their list and place on it; or, without a name, every block of the hall with who sits there. Ministers of the outgoing government who were not elected sit at the government table without a seat. Also lists the elected candidates who gave up their seat before the oath, with sources.

lang.description: Language for names and texts (default en).

name.description: A member’s name in Hebrew, English, Russian or French, e.g. "Bennett", "בנט", "Беннет".

name: get_knesset_seating
title: Who sits where in the Knesset
